preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n or pi == -1 for pi in managers)
preconditions.description: Each manager index pi is either between 1 and n or -1.

preconditions.expression: all(pi != i for i, pi in enumerate(managers, start=1))
preconditions.description: No employee is their own manager.

postconditions.description: The number of groups is positive.

postconditions.expression: all(not (is_superior(i, j) and is_superior(j, i)) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) if i != j)
postconditions.description: There are no pairs of employees where one is the superior of the other and vice versa.

postconditions.expression: all(any(is_superior(i, j) for j in group) or any(is_superior(j, i) for j in group) for group in groups for i in group)
postconditions.description: Within any group, there are no two employees where one is the superior of the other.

postconditions.expression: sum(len(group) for group in groups) == n
postconditions.description: All employees are assigned to exactly one group.
